2609.00073.title: MiNER: Fine-Tuned Biomedical Natural Language Processing for Malaria Disease Entity Recognition in Clinical Texts
2609.00073.paper_summary: Malaria remains a significant global health burden, necessitating continuous research efforts to understand its complex molecular mechanisms, epidemiology, and potential therapeutic interventions. Extracting essential biomedical information from the vast and constantly growing malaria literature is a challenging task that demands innovative approaches. Recently, pre-trained language models have revolutionized natural language processing tasks, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in various domains. This paper proposes a fine-tuned pre-trained biomedical language model for biomedical information extraction from scientific literature on malaria disease. The proposed methodology selects and preprocesses a large corpus of scientific articles on malaria, and then annotates them with entities of clinical significance. It then leverages BioBERT, a state-of-the-art pre-trained language model, to encode the textual data into context-aware representations. We fine-tune the model using domain-specific annotations and supervised learning to enhance its ability to extract relevant biomedical named entities. Extensive experiments and comparisons with different encoding and machine learning algorithms show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms them in precision, recall, and accuracy. We also publish our human-labeled dataset for entity and relation extraction to enable other health informatics researchers to train advanced models for malaria information extraction.
2609.00073.paper_summary_zh: 疟疾仍然是全球健康的重要負擔，這需要持續的研究努力來理解其複雜的分子機制、流行病學和潛在的治療干預措施。從龐大且不斷增長的疟疾文獻中提取基本的生物醫學信息是一項挑戰性的任務，這需要創新的方法。最近，預訓練的語言模型徹底改變了自然語言處理任務，在各個領域展現了卓越的能力。本文提出了一種針對疟疾科學文獻的生物醫學信息提取的微調預訓練生物醫學語言模型。所提出的方法選擇並預處理了大量關於疟疾的科學文章，然後用臨床重要性的實體進行註釋。接著，利用BioBERT這一最先進的預訓練語言模型，將文本數據編碼為上下文感知的表示。我們使用特定領域的註釋和監督學習來微調模型，以增強其提取相關生物醫學命名實體的能力。廣泛的實驗和與不同編碼和機器學習算法的比較顯示，所提出的方法在精確度、召回率和準確性方面顯著優於它們。我們還發布了我們的人類標註數據集，用於實體和關係提取，以使其他健康信息學研究人員能夠訓練先進的疟疾信息提取模型。
